finding_ids.claim: 48/48 measures independent NL semantic correct classification
finding_ids.counterexample: All 48 so-called private gold predictions regenerate entirely from public.json plus author-maintained generator; exact digest match. Not independent NL labels.

finding_ids.claim: 48-case balanced sample is a new independent unseen task distribution
finding_ids.counterexample: make_all line 94 stratifies by its own reference closure label and uses same source policy; original 10 and 17 excluded only by IDs. Distribution not independent.

finding_ids.claim: SHA-bound source and input cannot be bypassed
finding_ids.counterexample: python -O disables assert in load and score; edited public accepted; unpinned fake EC module code actually executed.

finding_ids.claim: local manifest hashes prove irrevocable freeze
finding_ids.counterexample: Modified public + modified gold + recomputed local manifest all accepted in ordinary python, because no out-of-band manifest hash checked.

finding_ids.claim: there is no answer or judge data accessible in artifacts
finding_ids.counterexample: native_score.json embeds formal_reference beside each native output; ONLY public.json does not contain explicit gold-key fields. Existing results must never be model-visible.

finding_ids.claim: 17/17 EC vs 1/17 Qwen proves general LLM semantic inferiority
finding_ids.counterexample: Generated contract-specific fixture and single constrained 1.5B inference; downstream simulated; no withheld independent unseen evaluation, and all LLM outputs collapsed to REFRAME.

finding_ids.claim: original 10-task raw candidate selector assessed semantic competence
finding_ids.counterexample: Raw generator names all positive IDs vN, negative x1 and marks correct-only claim/evidence; older trivial 10/10 by prefix. Current projector removes literal fields; possible semantic_operation lexical proxies remain.

rerun_requirements: New source-independent NL-grounded reference adjudicator kept out of both model prompts and author generator; freeze before inference
Public model inputs in physically/access-separated store; never publish scorer or gold to predictor
Convert integrity asserts to explicit unconditional raises; pinned fixed manifest hash must live outside writable corpus
Before scoring, source-hash native EC module and fail closed even under python -O
Run real LLM on exact frozen predictor-visible bytes; no post-hoc sample selection on hidden labels
Target-only intervention A-E with non-target hashes and capability parity

note: Adversarial tests were performed on a temporary copy. No original data or source mutated. The 48/48 tally is not alleged arithmetically false; the scientific interpretation and integrity certification fail.
